t_advice_summary_textbox.text: If the red, purple, brown or pink gnome is selected, the red basket will be chosen. If the yellow. blue, orange, or green gnome is selected, the yellow basket will be chosen. One of the baskets, either red or yellow will provide more mushrooms for a certain period of time. Therefore, you should try to figure out which basket is giving more mushrooms and switch when supply is low.

vb_textbox.text: There are two baskets: red and yellow. If you selected the red, purple, brown, or pink gnome, the red basket will be chosen. On the other hand, if you select the yellow, orange, blue, or green gnome, the yellow basket will be chosen. One of the baskets, either red or yellow, will provide more mushrooms for short periods of time throughout the game. This feature alternates and changes randomly throughout the game. Therefore, it is important to identify and work out which basket (red or yellow) is giving more mushrooms and keep selecting the relevant gnome for the intended basket associated with giving more mushrooms to be chosen (i.e choosing the purple gnome for the red basket to be chosen) until the supply of mushrooms runs very low. It is then advisable to then switch to the other basket by choosing the gnomes that are linked to that specific basket to be chosen. Repeat this by constantly identifying and switching between baskets to gather the most amount of mushrooms possible.
